title: Spicy Grilled Broccoli
description: Loaded with flavor and lightly charred, this grilled broccoli is brushed with a spicy-sweet gochujang sauce for a bold Korean-inspired side dish.
ingredients: 0.33333334326744 cup vegetable oil, plus more for grill
4 small heads broccoli, cut into broccoli steaks

steps.text: To make the sauce: Whisk vegetable oil, soy sauce, gochujang, honey, lime juice, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes together in a bowl until well combined.
Preheat an outdoor grill for low heat and lightly oil the grate.
Place broccoli steaks onto hot grill, cover, and cook for 2 minutes. Flip and cook for another 2 minutes.

Flip broccoli steaks and generously brush with sauce, coating the stems well. Cook until lightly charred and beginning to soften, 5 to 7 minutes. Flip broccoli steaks and generously brush with sauce again. Cook until the stems are tender-crisp and cooked through, 5 to 7 minutes more.
